lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Naomi and Ruth walked the long road from Moab toward Bethlehem—dusty, weary, but together. The hills rose and fell like waves of stone and dry grass.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: We will follow the road. Step by step. I am with you, Naomi.

lines.speaker: naomi
lines.text: You should not have come. There is nothing for you here. The Almighty has made my life very bitter.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They passed through the rocky valleys, keeping to the paths that travelers knew—avoiding the dangerous shortcuts.

choices.label: Stay on the safe path
choices.note: The faithful path is patient and steady.

choices.label: Offer Naomi your arm
choices.note: Ruth supports her mother-in-law as the road steepens.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At last, the walls of Bethlehem appeared on the horizon. The whole town was stirred by their arrival.
